ACTION=A3
Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph (approx. 13.9 m/s) while approaching a slower lead vehicle at a distance of 28 meters traveling at only 4.6 m/s. Given the closing speed, braking (deceleration) is required to avoid a rear-end collision. Action A3 corresponds to a moderate deceleration level appropriate for this scenario.
